observed: The signed-in Tencent Cloud main account APPID is 1257392443, matching the media bucket suffix.
The bucket is absent from the standard COS console but present in Lighthouse object storage, ap-shanghai, with private read/write access.
The existing service credential can head the bucket but its bucket-versioning and prefix-list preflight returned AccessDenied; the active API/Worker were not upgraded.
diagnosis: Tencent documents that Lighthouse COS buckets may not appear in the standard COS list and that its SDK compatibility excludes bucket-level operations. The suppression replay implementation requires GetBucketVersioning and GetBucket. A standard private COS bucket must be selected for those markers; the existing media bucket stays in place.
sourceChange: PRIVACY_SUPPRESSION_BUCKET selects a separate standard COS bucket for the existing suppression remote; production rejects use of a Lighthouse COS bucket for that remote. No new product module or media migration is required.
status: Code prepared; standard private bucket and its effective service access have not been provisioned or verified.
